title: Finding the Art Room on a Small Campus
text: Mia: Excuse me, Tom. Where is the art room? Tom: It is next to the library. Go straight and turn left at the café. Mia: Is there a map near the gate? Tom: Yes, there is. Look, two students are drawing on it. Mia: Are there any chairs in the art room? Tom: No, there aren't. But there are six tables. Mia: What is the teacher doing now? Tom: She is opening the window. Please don't run in the hall. Mia: Thank you. Oh, is that your bag? Tom: No, it isn't. My bag is under the desk. Mia: Sorry! Tom: That's OK. The art room is very quiet now.
